Book questions

What this book is for

Answered from the same facts the shelf shows, nothing more.

Who is Computer Awareness for?

A short, exam-focused book for the computer section: hardware, MS Office, internet and networking basics.

What does Computer Awareness cover?

Computer fundamentals for competitive exams - hardware, software, MS Office, internet, networking and security - with practice questions.

Which exams is Computer Awareness useful for?

Punjab Police, PSSSB, Patwari, Staff Selection Commission, Banking Exams, General competitive.
